name: C2 Commercial, Height District 1VL (with Transitional Height)
source: LAMC 12.14 (C2 yards); 12.21.1 A.1 (1VL: 3 stories / 45 ft, FAR 1.5:1); 12.21.1 A.10 (Transitional Height)
verified: 2026-09-23 transitional height table (0-49 ft: 25 ft, 50-99 ft: 33 ft, 100-199 ft: 61 ft) confirmed; 1VL limits from CP-7150 summary; C2 yard rule (none for commercial use) re-confirm in 12.14 C
notes: C2 commercial use: no front, side or rear yard required. Residential use in C2 follows R4 yards (not modeled).

Transitional Height (12.21.1 A.10): where the lot is within 199 ft of a lot in RW1 or a more restrictive zone, portions of the building are limited by distance from that lot: 0-49 ft: 25 ft; 50-99 ft: 33 ft; 100-199 ft: 61 ft.
Flag the parcel edge that abuts the low-density lot as 'adjacent low density' for the transitional height to apply.
